faqs.question: What is TTU Online?
faqs.answer: Online offers fully online degree programs and courses designed for students who need flexibility in their education. Our programs are structured to provide the same high-quality education as on-campus courses but in a format that fits different schedules and lifestyles.

faqs.question: Who should enroll in Online Plus?
faqs.answer:
It is ideal for:
Working professionals balancing education with a careerMilitary personnel needing flexible degree options
Transfer students wanting an accelerated online pathwayAnyone who wants to complete a bachelor’s degree faster, with 8-week terms

faqs.question: Is TTU Online accredited?
faqs.answer: Yes, Texas Tech University is fully accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC), and our online programs meet the same rigorous standards as on-campus programs.

faqs.question: How do I enroll?
faqs.answer: Visit the Online Plus admissions page on TTU’s website for program details and application instructions, or call (806) 742-5944 to speak with an enrollment specialist.

faqs.question: I only have a high school diploma and no prior college credits. Can I enroll in Online Plus?
faqs.answer: Yes, first-time freshmen can enroll in Online Plus. You’ll follow Texas Tech University’s standard admissions process (including high school transcripts and SAT or ACT scores if required). Once admitted, you can begin taking eight-week accelerated online courses in your chosen major. Your advisor will help you plan a schedule that works best for your goals.

faqs.question: Can I transfer credits into Texas Tech Online?
faqs.answer: Yes, transfer credits are evaluated on a case-by-case basis. Your Enrollment Service Specialist can assist.

faqs.question: How do I register for online classes?
faqs.answer: Students register through Raiderlink, just like on-campus students. Your Online Student Advocate can assist with course selection and registration.

faqs.question: Can I take online and on-campus classes at the same time?
faqs.answer: It depends on your program. Some students may be able to mix formats, while others must stick to fully online coursework. Contact your TTU Online Admissions for details.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Business Administration in General Business?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Business Administration in General Business is designed for working professionals and nontraditional students, this flexible program offers hands-on learning, expert faculty, and opportunities to earn credit for prior work-life experience. Whether you’re advancing in your current role or pursuing new career opportunities, Texas Tech’s Online BBA prepares you to lead, innovate, and thrive.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Science in Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Science in Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence prepares students to tackle AI challenges by combining technology, social sciences and the arts. This interdisciplinary program focuses on user experience, ethical AI practices and real-world application, enabling students to create solutions that benefit society. With a curriculum that goes beyond coding, you will learn how to design AI solutions that prioritize ethics, fairness and user experience. Gain hands-on experience through capstone projects, internships and workshops while collaborating with industry professionals. Graduates are equipped for high-demand careers in AI research, UX design, data science and technology management, with strong job growth in these fields. Learn how to create responsible AI that makes a real-world impact in industries like health care, finance and technology.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Science in Computing Applications?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Science in Computing Applications prepares students for high-demand careers by integrating computing with fields like digital media, biotechnology and cybersecurity. This program builds expertise in programming, software development and interdisciplinary problem-solving. Students benefit from faculty with expertise in a wide range of computer science fields, gaining, in the process, valuable mentorship opportunities and access to cutting-edge research offered by industry-proven professionals as they explore innovative applications of computing. With hands-on learning, faculty mentorship and prior learning assessment opportunities, students gain the technical and creative skills employers seek. Career-focused and high-demand, this program equips graduates with expertise in computing applications across fields such as digital media, cybersecurity, biotechnology and environmental sustainability, making them sought-after professionals. Affordable tuition and industry-recognized micro credentials enhance career readiness, making this degree an ideal path for those looking to thrive in today’s tech-driven job market.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Science in Counseling and Addiction Recovery Sciences?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Science in Counseling & Addiction Recovery Sciences is designed for individuals passionate about making a difference in the lives of others. With flexible online courses, this program equips you with the skills to navigate counseling and addiction recovery while preparing you for career advancement in human services. Whether you're pursuing a direct career path or preparing for graduate studies, this program provides a strong foundation for success. You'll also gain hands-on experience through a practicum in your local community, helping you build practical skills and confidence. Graduates are prepared for careers in human services or further education, with many continuing to master’s programs in counseling, social work, or marriage and family therapy. This program also meets the academic requirements for becoming a Licensed Chemical Dependency Counselor, opening doors to specialized roles in addiction treatment and recovery.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Criminology?
faqs.answer: The online Bachelor of Arts in Criminology offers a flexible, career-focused education designed to equip you with the knowledge and skills needed to thrive in the criminal justice field. This program blends academic theory with real-world applications, preparing you for a wide range of careers in law enforcement, government, social services and more. With an emphasis on critical thinking, criminal behavior and societal impact, you'll gain a deep understanding of crime, criminal behavior and the criminal justice system. This degree combines key concepts from sociology, law, psychology and public policy, helping you understand how crime affects society and how the justice system responds. Graduates are prepared to address societal challenges and create positive change. Plus, Texas Tech’s online format allows you to balance your studies with work and family commitments, ensuring your education fits into your life. Start your journey today and explore how this degree can open doors to a rewarding and impactful career in criminology.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Science in Leadership Studies?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Science in Leadership Studies degree is designed for nontraditional students, this flexible program combines leadership theory with practical skills to prepare you for careers in business, human resources, public administration and more. Whether you're balancing work, family or military service, this online degree offers the flexibility to learn on your terms.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Applied Arts and Sciences in Applied Leadership?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Applied Arts and Sciences in Applied Leadership degree program is ideal for nontraditional learners, including working professionals and military personnel, seeking a degree that aligns with their busy lives and career aspirations. With competitive tuition rates, opportunities to earn credit for work and life experience, and specialized concentrations, the BAAS degree prepares you for roles in human resources, project management, business administration and beyond.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Human Resources Development?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts in Human Resources Development offers you the opportunity to advance your career in human resources with a flexible interdisciplinary approach. This degree prepares you to improve workplace learning, employee development and organizational growth while balancing the demands of your personal and professional life. The HRDV program’s curriculum focuses on critical human resources topics such as talent management, workplace leadership, compliance and strategic organizational development, providing practical knowledge that can be immediately applied in your career.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Legal Studies?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts in Legal Studies is designed for students eager to pursue a career in law or related fields. This interdisciplinary program combines a strong foundation in legal theory with practical, hands-on experiences, such as internships, mock trials and a capstone project. As a graduate, you'll be prepared for law school or a variety of legal careers, including paralegal, compliance officer or public policy advisor. The curriculum emphasizes critical thinking, legal research and effective communication, ensuring you're ready for both immediate employment and further graduate study. Gain real-world legal experience that sets you apart and equips you with the skills employers value most. Start your journey today and explore how this flexible, affordable program can help you achieve your professional goals.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Organizational Leadership?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts in Organizational Leadership prepares you to excel in today’s fast-paced business environment. This online program combines strategic decision-making, ethical leadership and hands-on learning to develop essential skills for leadership roles in industries like business management, human resources, healthcare and consulting. The curriculum blends leadership theory with real-world applications, with courses like Strategic Storytelling for Leaders and Leading Organizational Change preparing you to lead teams and drive change in any organization. Learn from experienced faculty who bring real-world insights to the classroom and provide personalized mentorship to help you apply leadership strategies in dynamic business environments. Graduates are well-equipped for leadership positions that demand both critical thinking and practical solutions.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Kinesiology?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts in Kinesiology aims to advance your career in health, fitness and human movement with Texas Tech University’s Bachelor of Science in Kinesiology—available fully online or in a hybrid format on campus in Lubbock. This flexible program is designed for students interested in the science of human movement, exercise and wellness, preparing them for careers in health, fitness, rehabilitation, and beyond. Build a strong foundation in exercise science, nutrition for exercise and performance, biomechanics, applied exercise physiology and exercise testing and prescription. The curriculum is tailored to provide industry-relevant skills that set you apart in the job market, while also preparing you for advanced studies and careers in physical therapy, occupational therapy, strength and conditioning, cardiac rehabilitation and other health-related fields.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Science in Applied Personal Finance?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Science in Applied Personal Finance is designed for those looking to build a successful career in personal finance with flexibility, practical skills and a focus on real-world financial planning. Whether you are a working professional, a military service member or a transfer student, this degree program offers a unique opportunity to advance your career without disrupting your life. You'll develop essential, marketable skills in industry-standard tools like Excel, consumer financial management, financial counseling and communication—high-demand skills that employers are seeking. Upon completion, you’ll also be eligible to take the Accredited Financial Counselor® exam, a credential recognized across the financial counseling and planning industry that can help you stand out in a competitive job market.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Digital Media and Professional Communication?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts in Digital Media & Professional Communication is designed for those ready to launch or elevate their careers in the dynamic field of digital media. This fully online program provides the flexibility to fit your schedule while delivering a career-focused education that prepares you for in-demand roles like digital media specialist or media professional.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts and Sciences in Human Sciences?
faqs.answer: The Bachelor of Applied Arts & Sciences in Human Sciences is an interdisciplinary degree designed to help you build on your professional experience, integrate your vocational skills with academic knowledge, and accelerate your career. Offered fully online or in a hybrid format on campus in Lubbock, this degree provides flexibility to complete coursework while managing family and work commitments. With a focus on multiple fields within the College of Health & Human Sciences, you can tailor your education to your career goals by choosing from three areas of concentration, including Addictive Disorders and Nutritional Sciences—allowing you to design a path that aligns with your passions and aspirations. The career-oriented curriculum prepares you for a variety of roles in health care administration, human resources, nonprofit leadership, and more, making it ideal for those looking to apply their work experience in meaningful ways.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies offers non-traditional students a customizable, flexible pathway to a degree that fits their personal and professional goals. This program allows you to select three unique concentrations across various disciplines, creating a personalized academic journey. Whether you’re interested in environmental science, communication or business, you can blend subjects that match your aspirations and career goals, preparing you for a wide array of career opportunities.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Psychology?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts in Psychology is designed for flexibility and empowers non-traditional students to balance education with life’s commitments while gaining a deep understanding of human behavior, cognition, and emotion.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Anthropology?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts in Anthropology is uniquely positioned to educate and engage students about the human condition. In doing so, our faculty take an integrated view of humanity from its deep past to diverse modernity.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Communication Studies?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts in Communication Studies is designed for working professionals, career changers, and nontraditional students who need a flexible path to a degree. This program provides industry-relevant skills in strategic communication, digital media, corporate communication and technical writing—helping you advance in your current role or pivot to a new career.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in English?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts in English offers a comprehensive education in literature, language and writing, preparing you for a wide range of careers in today’s competitive job market. This program covers British and American literature, creative and professional writing, linguistics and literary theory, equipping you with the skills needed for critical analysis and effective communication. With flexible electives, you can tailor your studies to your personal interests, allowing you to specialize in areas such as writing, editing or education. Graduates are well-prepared for careers in education, writing, publishing and more, or can pursue further academic opportunities. This program is also offered in a hybrid format in Lubbock, combining the flexibility of online learning with in-person engagement.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Political Science?
faqs.answer: The Bachelor of Arts in Political Science offers a comprehensive education in domestic and international policy and governmental structures. This program develops essential analytical and communication skills for careers in law, public administration, advocacy, journalism and more. With a strong emphasis on critical thinking and policy analysis, graduates are prepared for leadership roles in both the public and private sectors.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Public Relations and Strategic Communication Management?
faqs.answer: The Bachelor of Arts in Writing, Design & Technical Communication offers a flexible and industry-relevant path to success. Our program provides hands-on learning opportunities, with a focus on interaction design and user experience (UX), making it ideal for aspiring content strategists, user experience designers and more. With a proven track record of steady job growth and competitive salaries, this program prepares you for a rewarding career in a variety of fields.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts in Writing, Design, and Technical Communication?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts in Writing, Design, and Technical Communication allows you to learn all the business fundamentals from marketing and consumer behavior to management and sales. You will graduate with expert knowledge of the technology used by the fashion industry including 3D, AR, and VR. Your courses will dive into key merchandising skills and how to manage fashion planning and strategy.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Arts and Science in Restaurant, Hotel, and Institution Management?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Arts and Science in Restaurant, Hotel, and Institution Management program focuses on lodging, travel, food, beverage, and hospitality business, will put you on the fast track to earning a bachelor's degree. You can earn your bachelor's degree in as little as 2 years and be prepared for a career in hotel, restaurant, or hospitality management. Turning your associate of applied sciences degree into a bachelor's degree allows you to earn higher salaries in leadership and management positions in the hospitality management field.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Science in Plant and Soil Science?
faqs.answer: The Online Bachelor of Science in Plant & Soil Science empowers you with the knowledge and hands-on skills to tackle these global challenges. Designed for aspiring professionals in agriculture, horticulture, viticulture and environmental sustainability, this program blends science, technology and industry insights to prepare you for a rewarding career in the field.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of Science in Renewable Energy?
faqs.answer: As the renewable energy sector continues to thrive, Texas Tech University offers both an online and hybrid Bachelor of Science in Renewable Energy designed for students eager to make an impact. This interdisciplinary program combines academic rigor with practical experience, preparing you for diverse careers in wind, solar, geothermal and more. Whether you choose the flexibility of online learning or the structured support of in-person classes in Lubbock, Texas Tech’s program offers the comprehensive curriculum and real-world experience you need to succeed.

faqs.question: What is the Online Bachelor of General Studies in Arts and Sciences Multidisciplinary Studies?
faqs.answer: The Online B.G.S. in Arts and Sciences Multidisciplinary Studies empowers you to design a degree that fits your passions, career goals and busy life. This flexible, interdisciplinary program lets you customize your education by choosing courses from three areas of concentration, giving you the freedom to build a personalized academic path that aligns with growing job markets and emerging industries.

faqs.question: What are eight-week terms?
faqs.answer: Eight-week terms allow students to complete courses in half the time of a traditional 16-week semester. Instead of taking multiple classes over a long semester, you’ll focus on fewer courses at a time in a more accelerated format.

faqs.question: How many courses should I take with eight-week terms?
faqs.answer: Students typically take one or two courses per eight-week term, depending on their workload. Full-time students take six credit hours per term (twelve per semester), and part-time students take three credit hours per term.

faqs.question: Will courses be harder with 8-week terms?
faqs.answer: The academic rigor and learning outcomes match standard 16-week courses. Because you’re on an accelerated schedule, expect a heavier weekly workload. However, focusing on fewer courses at a time often helps students manage the pace effectively.

faqs.question: How do eight-week terms affect my graduation timeline?
faqs.answer: Many students can complete their degrees faster than in a traditional 16-week format. Your Online Student Advocate or Academic Advisor can help you build a course plan to stay on track, potentially finishing ahead of a standard 4-year schedule.Texas Tech Online Plus Program: Student Support Services

faqs.question: What technology do I need to Texas Tech Online?
faqs.answer:
At minimum, you’ll need:
A reliable internet connection.
A computer that meets system requirements for Canvas.
A webcam and microphone for proctored exams or virtual meetings.

faqs.question: How do I access my online courses?
faqs.answer: Courses are hosted in Canvas, which you can access through Raiderlink.

faqs.question: What if I have technical issues?
faqs.answer: Contact IT Help Central at (806) 742-4357 or visit IT Help Central.

faqs.question: What if I need to take a break from school?
faqs.answer: Students can take time off but should consult with an Online Student Advocate to avoid affecting financial aid or degree progress.

faqs.question: Is financial aid available for online students?
faqs.answer: Yes, online students are eligible for federal financial aid, scholarships, and military benefits, just like on-campus students. Contact the Financial Aid Office for details.

faqs.question: Are there extra fees for online classes?
faqs.answer: Some courses may have additional fees for materials, technology, or proctored exams, but tuition rates are the same as in-person classes.

faqs.question: Can I use VA benefits or military tuition assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes, TTU Online is military-friendly and benefits can be applied toward tuition. Speak with our Military & Veterans Programs office for assistance.
